title: The unreleased Adrian Rollini trio record
summary: He recorded for anyone he could make a dollar with, including a Brunswick trio session under Adrian Rollini's name.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Do you remember making those records with Adrian Rollini?
OH, yeah.
That's a long time ago.
Oh, boy. Adrian Rollini. Wonder what
happened to him. Has he passed?
I don't know. I guess so. It's been a long time.
Adrian Rollini.
Whose idea was that? That's an unusual, you know -- that record you made which was never released.
I forgot what it was now.
Well, it was with Adrian Rollini on baritone sax, and Snake -- (bass sax-ed)
Snake.
-- on the piano. What's his real name?
I don't know.
Sorba or something like that?
I don't know.
An Italian name, I think. Sorba or Scorba.
I don't know.
Something like that. And then yourself. Just the trio. Whose idea was that? Do you remember at all?
It probably was whoever had the session.
I think it was under Adrian's name.
Well, he had the session, then. If it was
under his name. Gee, it's been so many years ago.
That was on Brunswick.
Yeah. I recorded for everyone I could make a dollar with. I was younger then, you know.
What's that?
I was young.
Oh, sure.
Wanted that money to carry in my pocket. It wouldn't stay there long, but I carried it one time.
